pwf.flow.tree.help.text: Choose a phase to filter the task board, choose a task to open it. Colour and words say whether a task is late, needs attention, is on hold or is fine.
pwf.flow.tree.caption.text: Tree of the phases and tasks of the workflow
pwf.flow.tree.phase.aria: Phase {name}: {done} of {total} required tasks done, {count} tasks
pwf.flow.gantt.help.text: The solid bar is the current schedule. The dashed bar runs from the current start to the finish of the first baseline; what passes the dashed bar is the delay against the baseline. A task on the critical path has the word "critical" after its code.

pwf.flow.board.failed.text: The list of tasks could not be read.
pwf.flow.board.due.label: Due
pwf.flow.gate.closed.word: Closed: the command cannot run yet
pwf.flow.gate.missing.label: Tasks still missing
pwf.flow.gate.failed.text: The detail of this gate could not be read, showing the count from the workflow.
pwf.flow.gate.none.text: This workflow template declares no phase that blocks a project command.
pwf.flow.partial.text: Part of the data could not be read: the schedule, the task list or the gates. The rest is correct as of the time it was read.
pwf.flow.stale.text: The figures may be out of date: computed at {time} (source time). Read them again.
pwf.flow.info.bands.name: Tasks by deadline colour
pwf.flow.info.bands.formula: Days left = forecast deadline minus today (Vietnam time), counted in working days. Compared with the thresholds of the three-colour policy: red, yellow, green. Only the official colour is used.
pwf.flow.info.bands.source: The tracked tasks of the workflow and the three-colour policy in force
pwf.flow.info.critical.name: Tasks on the critical path
pwf.flow.info.critical.formula: Tasks whose total float is not above the critical threshold (default 0 working days) on the current schedule.
pwf.flow.info.critical.source: The current schedule of the workflow, built on the working calendar pinned by year
pwf.flow.info.finish.name: Expected project finish
pwf.flow.info.finish.formula: The latest finish of any task on the current schedule. When the working calendar of a year is missing, no date is published.
pwf.flow.info.finish.source: The current schedule of the workflow
pwf.flow.info.variance.name: Delay against the baseline
pwf.flow.info.variance.formula: Current finish minus the finish of the first baseline; positive is late, negative is early.
pwf.flow.info.variance.source: The current schedule and the first baseline of the project
pwf.flow.info.count.name: Tasks shown
pwf.flow.info.count.formula: The total is the exact count of every task that matches the filter; the number shown is how many were read so far, the rest is read on request.
pwf.flow.info.count.source: The task list of the workflow, read by cursor
pwf.flow.info.gate.name: Stage gate
pwf.flow.info.gate.formula: A gate is open when every required task of the project branch in the phases that guard the command is done and approved, waived with approval, or cancelled with approval.
pwf.flow.info.gate.source: The gate declarations of the frozen template and the state of the tasks
pwf.flow.info.phase.name: Required tasks done in the phase
pwf.flow.info.phase.formula: Required tasks done divided by the required tasks of the phase. The open phase is the first one that still has a required task to do.
pwf.flow.info.phase.source: The tasks of the workflow, from the state of each task
pwf.flow.info.float.name: Total float
pwf.flow.info.float.formula: Total float = the latest finish minus the earliest finish of the task, in working days.
pwf.flow.info.float.source: The current schedule of the workflow
